name: Kitchen Cleaning Checklist
description: A thorough kitchen cleaning checklist covering appliances, surfaces, the sink, fridge, and floors.

items.text: Wash, dry, and put away any dishes in the sink or rack
Clear countertops and set items aside to wipe surfaces fully
Empty the trash and recycling and add fresh liners
Put away groceries, condiments, and stray pantry items
Gather your cleaning supplies and a fresh dish cloth
Wipe down and disinfect all countertops
Clean and degrease the backsplash
Wipe cabinet fronts, handles, and drawer pulls
Disinfect high-touch spots like light switches and faucet handles
Wipe down the windowsill and any open shelving
Clean the stovetop and scrub the burner grates or coils
items.note: Soak removable grates in hot soapy water while you clean the rest.

items.text: Wipe the oven door and clean the interior if needed
Clean the inside and outside of the microwave
Wipe down the toaster, kettle, and coffee maker
Polish stainless steel surfaces and appliance fronts
Degrease the range hood and wipe or replace the filter
Discard expired food and leftovers
Wipe down shelves, drawers, and door bins
Clean spills and sticky spots inside the fridge
Wipe the exterior, handles, and the top of the fridge
Vacuum the coils and floor behind the fridge during deep cleans
Check and wipe the freezer, removing any frost buildup
Scrub the sink basin and remove any stains
Disinfect the faucet, handles, and sprayer
Clean and freshen the garbage disposal
Clear the drain and remove trapped food debris
Wipe down the dish rack and soap dispenser
Sweep up crumbs and debris, including under the toe-kicks
Mop the floor, paying attention to corners and under appliances
Wipe down the trash and recycling bins
Replace dish towels and the sink sponge
Do a final wipe of counters and a quick inspection

faq.q: What order should I clean my kitchen in?
faq.a: Clear and wipe counters first, then clean appliances, scrub the sink, and finish with the floor. Working top to bottom keeps crumbs and drips from landing on areas you've already cleaned.

faq.q: How often should I deep clean my kitchen?
faq.a: Wipe surfaces daily and do a fuller clean weekly. Deep tasks like the oven, fridge interior, and behind appliances are best done monthly or every couple of months.

faq.q: How do I clean a kitchen sink and disposal?
faq.a: Scrub the basin with baking soda, disinfect the faucet and handles, and freshen the disposal by grinding ice and citrus peels. Rinse thoroughly afterward.

faq.q: What is the best way to clean a greasy stovetop?
faq.a: Spray with a degreaser or all-purpose cleaner, let it sit a few minutes, then wipe. For stubborn buildup, a baking soda paste lifts grease without scratching.

faq.q: Is this kitchen cleaning checklist printable?
faq.a: Yes. You can print it or save the PDF and check off each task for daily, weekly, or deep kitchen cleaning.
